{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kashyyyk Academy of Wrestling''' was a wrestling academy that was established by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Rrawkee]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He believed that the [[Cularin Trade Alliance]] would be vital to the success of the business and he exhibited as stand for the Academy at the [[Cularin Trade Show]], which was held aboard the ''[[TAV Prosperity]]''.
